risk.risk: Capacity, SMTP or auxiliary operations sources cannot be verified
risk.impact: Chat/jobs may contend for resources and some cards remain unavailable
risk.mitigation: State capacity is unassessed and measure before release. Keep a chat switch and contact route. Expose real at-least-once SMTP states. Label missing backup/storage sources unconnected; never buy services automatically.
risk.trigger: Capacity is insufficient, SMTP is unavailable, or verified backup completion metadata is missing
